reader.requirement: For a file (FD of any organization, or SD via RETURN) whose RECORD IS VARYING clause names DEPENDING ON data-name-1, every SUCCESSFUL READ or RETURN must leave in data-name-1 the number of character positions of the record just read; an unsuccessful one leaves it unchanged (GR9).
reader.edition-search: grep -n 'Edition|CobolVersion|DialectBehavior' over SequentialIoEmitter.cs, KeyedIoEmitter.cs, SortEmitter.cs: the only hit is DialectBehavior.SelectWhenOnlyForFilePhraseStatements (SequentialIoEmitter line 593), which selects a file-phrase record and is not on the length-store path; FileConnector.NoteRecordRead (the one writer of LastReadLength) has no edition test. The store is edition-neutral.

reader.notes: The DEPENDING item is stored from the runtime's LastReadLength (sequential/relative/indexed, via KeyedIoEmitter.EmitRead and SequentialIoEmitter.EmitRead inside the success branch) and from CobolSort.LastReturnedLength for RETURN. All six probe legs printed the record lengths and left the item unchanged on every unsuccessful READ/RETURN. The 2023 rerun of rcv11b was refused only for LABEL RECORDS (COBOL0902), unrelated to this rule.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR4-GR12 and READ GR13 (record length conflict: READ successful, 04). Read FileConnector.NoteRecordRead (LastReadLength = delivered length, clamped to VaryMax on truncation), SequentialIoEmitter.EmitRead (length store in the success branch, before the USE hook, so a 04 READ also stores) and SortEmitter.EmitReturn. Probe refute-1985-197/gr11c.cob at --std 85 (runs/gr11c-002): one physical file written through an FD of 1..30 and read through an FD of 5..10 DEPENDING ON a qualified PACKED-DECIMAL item: 'C1 LEN=10 ST=04' (30-char record truncated, successful), 'C2 LEN= 2 ST=04' (below minimum, successful), 'C3 LEN= 7 ST=00', 'C4 LEN=10 ST=04' (READ NEXT RECORD); MERGE of two varying USING files into an OUTPUT PROCEDURE with a BINARY/DISPLAY DEPENDING item: 'M A LEN=05 / M B LEN=12 / M C LEN=03 / M D LEN=02 / M AT END 02' (at-end RETURN leaves the item unchanged per GR9). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR11  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR11'; 'OK  §1985:VII.4.4.4 GR13  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR13'; 'OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR9  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR9'. The one reading taken: on a truncated (04) record 'the record just read' is the record as delivered (max size); the code records it as kb/Work PB5480 and it is the only reading consistent with GR13's truncation.
